purpose: Describe an action begun but not completed.
keywords: Verb stem + かける / かけの + noun
I put the book I had started reading on the desk.
I swallowed the words I had started to say.
I nearly fell on the stairs.
formation: Verb stem + かける / かけの + noun
restrictions: Some verbs also use this for being on the verge of an event.
mistake: かけ does not mean the action is finished.
